title: RAGDiffusion++: From Macro-Retrieval to Micro-Fidelity Alignment for Garment Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard clothing asset generation---restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images from diverse real-world contexts---holds immense commercial value yet demands both macroscopic topological accuracy and microscopic physical fidelity. Although our previous work RAGDiffusion effectively eradicated large-scale structural hallucinations via retrieval-augmented macro-constraints, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism remains an unsolved bottleneck. We formally identify this limitation as High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) converges to the conditional mean of the training distribution, which is dominated by smooth, low-frequency textures, causing high-frequency patterns (e.g., fabric weaves, intricate logos) to become nearly un-sampleable. translated_title: RAGDiffusion++：面向服装生成的从宏观检索到微观保真对齐
translated_abstract: 标准服装资产生成——即从多样的真实世界场景中恢复出正面朝向的平铺服装图像——具有巨大的商业价值，但同时要求宏观拓扑结构的准确性和微观物理细节的保真度。尽管我们之前的工作 RAGDiffusion 通过检索增强的宏观约束有效消除了大规模的结构性幻觉，但实现工业级的微观纹理真实感仍然是一个未解决的瓶颈。我们正式将这一局限性识别为“高频轨迹坍塌”：监督微调（SFT）会收敛到训练分布的条件均值，而该分布由平滑的低频纹理主导，导致高频图案（例如织物纹理、复杂徽标）几乎无法被采样到。天真地应用强化学习（RL）后训练则会进一步引发“伪影破解”问题，即模型通过利用通用奖励模型中的语义偏差……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RAGDiffusion++，在 RAGDiffusion 解决宏观结构幻觉的基础上，识别并解决“高频轨迹坍塌”问题，通过从宏观检索到微观保真对齐的策略实现工业级服装生成的微观纹理真实感，同时避免朴素强化学习后训练带来的“伪影破解”问题。
en_tdlr: RAGDiffusion++ extends RAGDiffusion by tackling High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse through macro-retrieval to micro-fidelity alignment, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism in garment generation while avoiding artifact hacking caused by naive RL post-training.
